manifest.name: channel-dead-letter
manifest.description: Failure inventory for channel sends that exhausted their bounded attempts (backlog:e5532d1c9146). Carries the phase, the normalized error code and the payload fingerprint — never the raw payload and never a secret. A human or an explicit requeue retries it; silent infinite retry is forbidden.

migrations.name: create_channel_dead_letters
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channel_dead_letters (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  connection_key TEXT,
  idempotency_key TEXT,
  job_id TEXT,
  phase TEXT CHECK(phase IN ('send')),
  error_code TEXT,
  payload_fingerprint TEXT,
  attempts INTEGER,
  first_failed_at TEXT,
  last_failed_at TEXT,
  state TEXT CHECK(state IN ('open', 'requeued', 'resolved')),
  state_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_dead_letters_space_id ON channel_dead_letters(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_dead_letters_connection_key ON channel_dead_letters(connection_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_dead_letters_idempotency_key ON channel_dead_letters(idempotency_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_dead_letters_state ON channel_dead_letters(state);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_channel_dead_letters
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."channel_dead_letters" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "connection_key" TEXT,
  "idempotency_key" TEXT,
  "job_id" TEXT,
  "phase" TEXT CHECK("phase" IN ('send')),
  "error_code" TEXT,
  "payload_fingerprint" TEXT,
  "attempts" BIGINT,
  "first_failed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "last_failed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "state" TEXT CHECK("state" IN ('open', 'requeued', 'resolved')),
  "state_reason" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "channel_dead_letters_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."channel_dead_letters"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "channel_dead_letters_connection_key"
  ON "accordo"."channel_dead_letters"("connection_key");

CREATE INDEX "channel_dead_letters_idempotency_key"
  ON "accordo"."channel_dead_letters"("idempotency_key");

CREATE INDEX "channel_dead_letters_state"
  ON "accordo"."channel_dead_letters"("state");
